name: @arpit194/themeforge-mcp
description: MCP server for ThemeForge — gives Claude knowledge of your token catalog

scripts.release:patch: git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: pre-release sync' && npm version patch --tag-version-prefix=mcp-v && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: pre-release sync' && npm version minor --tag-version-prefix=mcp-v && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: pre-release sync' && npm version major --tag-version-prefix=mcp-v && git push && git push --tags
